<thought>We need to locate a retrosynthetic template for the intramolecular Michael cyclization that converts a chalcone into a flavanone. The forward reaction forms a C–C bond (6‑6) and a C–O bond (6‑8) while breaking a C–O bond (6‑8). Functional groups formed are ether oxygens, and broken are ketones and aromatic hydroxyls (the phenolic OH that becomes part of the ether). Using these criteria should retrieve the appropriate template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1OC(Cc2ccccc2)C2=CC=CC=C12",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "aromatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6", "6-8"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
